what: root id -> [best oracle score, number of imaged ROIs, activity code, session, scan_idx, unit_id] for the ROI with the best oracle score
code: 60 characters = 6 oracle clips x 10 one-second bins (0-1 s ... 9-10 s after the clip starts). Each character is base-36 of floor(2*z), clamped 0..35, where z is that second's mean response (mean of 10 repeats, robust z of the raw fluorescence over the whole scan). So '4' = z >= 2.
